design.name: 熔心魔将
design.role: 3-3 铸范大坊领主（Unity 资产 SK_Boss_Warlord）；熔心大剑另建 SM_BossWeapon_Greatsword（inferno_boss_warlord_sword）
design.brief: A towering molten-copper demon warlord forged from cooled volcanic basalt and molten copper in the fire god Zhurong's foundry, a heavy two-handed greatsword swordsman about 4.2 m tall (horn tips): very broad shoulders, deep barrel chest, big armoured gauntlets, blocky sabatons, sturdy short legs, a compact head inside a big horned helm. Dark purple-grey basalt armour plates (about 60%), burnished copper trims, rivets, round ring bosses and crescent horns (about 25%), ink-black front and back tabards and belt tassels (about 10%); molten-orange lines only in the armour seams, the eye slit and the round furnace-heart ring in the chest.
design.style_note: pipeline.toml [concept].style, written out in the prompt: polished stylized cartoon 3D game art, toy-like chunky simplified masses, clean bevelled edges, flat-ish hand-painted colours, two or three dominant colour blocks; no photorealism, micro-grain, dense tiny cracks or fine engraving.
